description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Light Iron is hiring a Software Engineer to build, improve, and maintain software tools that support its post-production workflows. The role develops and maintains workflow solutions, integrates software with production infrastructure, and supports deployment and troubleshooting alongside engineering and technical operations teams.
Software Engineer building post-production workflow tools and services with Python microservices, MongoDB, and Docker deployment

Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain the software and workflow tools that keep post-production running smoothly
• Develop features and services in Python within a microservices architecture, applying established design patterns
• Design and write efficient queries and data models using MongoDB Atlas
• Package and deploy services using Docker and the team’s established deployment practices
• Troubleshoot and resolve software issues affecting production workflows, escalating to the Director of Product Engineering as needed
• Collaborate with the software team to identify areas where software tools can improve workflow efficiency and implement solutions
• Collaborate with other departments, including data operators, editors, artists, and producers, to ensure software solutions integrate smoothly with existing workflows
• Work with the Engineering team to ensure software integrates effectively with production infrastructure, storage, and network systems
• Work with Technical Operations to support the deployment and day-to-day use of software tools and to respond to issues raised by operators
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to team-wide best practices for software development
• Create and maintain technical documentation for software tools and workflows
• Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly and in line with the company’s content security and data handling requirements
• Explore new technologies and industry trends, and bring the best ideas back to the team

Requirements:
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
• Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams
• A passion for learning and growing as an engineer
• Curiosity about new technologies and how they can improve creative workflows
• Attention to detail and commitment to writing clean, maintainable code
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced production environment
• Interest in building tools that support filmmakers and creative production teams
• Technical B.S. or equivalent professional experience
• 1+ years of experience in software development
• Understanding of microservices architecture and design patterns
• Strong knowledge of Python
• Hands-on experience with MongoDB Atlas and writing efficient queries
• Experience with Docker and containerization
• Proficiency with Git or similar version control systems
• Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools in daily workflows

Preferred:
• Proficiency in JavaScript and Vue, and the ability to work across languages and technology stacks (e.g., Node.js, REST API)
• Cloud experience (AWS preferred) and infrastructure-as-code experience (Serverless Framework or Terraform)
• Experience working in a post-production facility
• Experience with post-production APIs such as MASV, Aspera/Faspex, or FilmLight
